Looking at the error and reviewing the code, I can see several issues that need to be fixed:

1. The scratchpad layout calculation is incorrect - B matrix placement and addressing
2. The MVIN operations have incorrect dimensions and addressing
3. The loop structure doesn't properly handle the tiling

Let me fix these issues:

```c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM; // 8 tiles (128 rows)
    int tj = MATMUL_N / DIM; // 8 tiles (128 columns)
    int tk = MATMUL_K / DIM; // 16 tiles (256 columns)
    
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    int SDST = 0;
    
    // 1. Initial configuration
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);
    
    // 2. Load scale factors once
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
    
    // 3. Load LUTs once
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1);
    
    // 4. Configure output streaming once
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 9);
    
    // 5. Load all B tiles into scratchpad once
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < tj; j++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k*DIM*MATMUL_N + j*DIM), bb + (j*tk + k)*DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // 6. Load A tiles and compute
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i*DIM*MATMUL_K + k*DIM), ab + (i*tk + k)*DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Execute the weight-stationary matmul on scratchpad data
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, bb, 0, SDST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
    
    // Drain results to DRAM
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], SDST * 16, MATMUL_M * MATMUL_N);
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
```
